scope: Independent post-run reconstruction and immutable source-member reconciliation; no kernels rerun.

primary_decision.criterion: fast_race: both geomean and aggregate-ratio lower 95% family-bootstrap bounds exceed 1 against sparse_pr, dense_pr_direct, and radix_pr; correctness also required.

radix_primary_decision.criterion: radix_pr: both geomean and aggregate-ratio lower 95% family-bootstrap bounds exceed 1 against sparse_pr, dense_pr_direct, dense_nearest_both, dense_pr_direct_radix, and dense_pr_nearest_radix; correctness also required.

radix_racing_decision.criterion: fast_race_radix: both geomean and aggregate-ratio lower 95% family-bootstrap bounds exceed 1 against sparse_pr, dense_pr_direct, radix_pr, dense_pr_direct_radix, and dense_pr_nearest_radix; correctness also required.

limitations: The holdout was previously studied in other experiments; it is held out for this new procedure only.
Floating-point containment is numerical, not formal outward rounding.
Retained curve bytes exclude other working arrays; this is not peak memory.
